description:
Calculates the end date of a submission or participation deadline in an EU procurement procedure. Intended for requests where the user asks by which date bids or requests to participate are due, or whether the minimum period can be shortened. Applies the minimum periods and reductions (electronic submission, prior information notice, urgency) of § 15–16 VgV and § 10a–10b VOB/A EU, shifts the end date to the next working day per Regulation (EEC, Euratom) 1182/71 and explains each step (rules as of 2026-07-14). Covers VgV (services and supplies) and VOB/A section 2 EU (construction). The § 134 GWB standstill period is calculated by calculate_standstill_period.

Example user questions: "Bis wann müssen Angebote eingehen?"; "Wie lange ist die Angebotsfrist bei einem offenen Verfahren nach VgV?"; "Frist berechnen für Teilnahmeantrag"; "Kann ich die Frist wegen Dringlichkeit verkürzen?"; "Wann endet die Angebotsfrist wenn ich heute veröffentliche?"

absendung.description: Date the contract notice is dispatched (ISO 2026-10-05 or German 05.10.2026). Day 0 — not counted towards the deadline.

dringlichkeit.description: Duly substantiated urgency applies (overrides other reductions, sets minimum deadline). Default: false.

elektronisch.description: Electronic tender submission available (reduces deadline by 5 days where permitted). Default: true.

regelwerk.description: Legal framework: vgv=Vergabeverordnung (services/supplies), voba=VOB/A Abschnitt 2 EU (construction).

verfahren.description: Procedure type. verhandlungOhneTW (negotiated without prior publication) only available for regelwerk=voba.

vorinformation.description: Prior information notice published at least 35 days before (allows shorter deadlines). Default: false.

name: calculate_tender_deadline
title: Angebots- und Teilnahmefristen berechnen
